context: A senpai and a teen chat
purpose: Teach: 分かれる/目立ち/気がつか/ゆかり/枯れ/残ら/落とさ/贈る

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 桜、ゼミ、二つに分かれる時、迷うよな。
lines.en: Sakura, when the seminar splits up like this, it's easy to feel unsure about which direction to go.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly hesitant. Speaking from genuine experience. Leans in conversationally. Warm but not presumptuous.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。発表で、目立ちすぎないように、心がけてます。
lines.en: Yes. I'm careful not to stand out too much during presentations.
lines.style: Sincere but measured. Not defensive — just honest about her approach. A slight apologetic edge, like she knows it's conservative but it's what feels safe.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 夜更かしで、体調変化、気がつかない時、危ない。
lines.en: But pulling all-nighters — you don't always notice what's happening to your body until it's too late.
lines.style: Firmer than before. A note of real concern underneath. Not lecturing, but this matters to him. Slow pace on the warning.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。先輩、地域ゆかりの研究、進めてますね。
lines.en: Yes. Senpai, your research on local communities is really coming along well.
lines.style: Respectful but genuine. Not empty flattery — she's actually noticed his work. Slight lift at the end, acknowledging something she admires.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 実験の植物、枯れさせないように、注意してる。
lines.en: I make sure the lab plants don't wilt. I'm careful about that.
lines.style: Quiet responsibility in the voice. Small, steady. Not dramatic — just someone noticing what needs tending. A touch of softness, almost protective.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。プリント、残らないようにしっかり配ります。
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure to hand out all the materials so nothing gets left behind.
lines.style: Brisk and capable. A hint of brightness — she's the kind to handle details without being asked. Efficient but not robotic. Small smile underneath.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 実験ノート、落とさないように、紐つけてる。
lines.en: I tied the lab notebooks together so I won't accidentally drop them.
lines.style: Simple, practical. Matter-of-fact but with a hint of self-awareness — a small quirk he's adopted. Not self-conscious about it. Straightforward delivery.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 卒業祝い、先輩に、心を込めて贈るつもりです。
lines.en: I'm planning to give you a graduation gift that I'll put real thought into.
lines.style: Quiet sincerity. Slight vulnerability underneath — this matters to her more than she's letting on. Warm, not shy but genuine. The last words don't rush.
